inputs.objective: Recover primary durable artifacts/provenance only; do not recreate missing economic results.

allowed_actions: search repository history, branches, commits, CI metadata and existing artifacts for the two named historical results
persist recovered provenance or an explicit unrecovered-blocker artifact
update only recovery metadata; preserve RESULT=UNKNOWN when primary evidence is not recovered
forbidden_actions: rerun or recreate Box Office or MLB/soccer/weather experiments
success_condition: For at least one target, either recover a primary durable artifact with exact provenance or persist an explicit exhausted-recovery result that leaves RESULT=UNKNOWN.
